status: frozen 2026-10-01 before any model saw the defined-transition prompt
decision: user 2026-10-01: prompt-definition ablation for Qwen3-14B, Llama-3.1-8B and R1-Distill-Qwen-14B (exp. log 2026-10-01 H2 analysis: 'decision transition' undefined; 4-6% read H as turns; 14B debated the term in 32% of H2 answers)

prompt_change.inserted_after_anchor: A decision transition is one action: playing one card or ending the turn.
prompt_change.rule: the anchor must occur exactly once in each user prompt; system prompt unchanged; nothing else changes

unchanged: fixtures (v3 release), oracle, scoring, request settings, serving stack, concurrency, truncation and pair gates

analysis.within_condition: same primary (same-oracle DiD at H8) and H8 lookahead curve as the base protocol, reported per model and character
analysis.primary_ablation_contrast: per model and character: DiD_defined - DiD_original at H8, paired by fixture (stratified bootstrap over fixtures within sensitive and control strata, 10,000 replicates, seed = base seed + 100); Holm correction across the 3 models x 2 characters at familywise alpha .05
analysis.secondary: H8 lookahead use (H8 answer is H8-optimal) defined vs original on sensitive fixtures, exact McNemar paired by fixture; H8 truncation and median completion tokens defined vs original
analysis.requires: the model's original-condition run must be complete and gate-valid for the ablation contrast; otherwise report descriptively
analysis.interpretation: a null contrast with a valid null within-condition DiD = robustness of the no-lookahead finding to the undefined term; a positive contrast = models fail partly by misreading the horizon instruction

exposure_note: these fixtures were already seen by each model under the original prompt (same model, different prompt); the ablation is a within-model paired comparison, not a fresh held-out test
